AN ORDINANCE OF THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL TO AMEND THE CHARTER OF THE CITY OF DORAVILLE TO REAPPORTION ELECTION DISTRICTS FOR THE CITY; TO ESTABLISH AN EFFECTIVE DATE; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

WHEREAS, the City of Doraville (“City”) recently annexed property from DeKalb County (“Annexation”), and a significant amount of the annexed property was residential located in Council District 2; and

WHEREAS, because of the Annexation, a population imbalance was created between Council District 1 and Council District 2; and

WHEREAS, pursuant to 0.C.G.A. Section 36-35-4.1, the City is authorized to reapportion the election districts from which members of the City Council are elected; and

WHEREAS, the City asked the State of Georgia Legislative and Congressional Reapportionment Office (“Reapportionment Office”) to review and develop a plan to redraw the City's Council Districts, to include the area subject to the Annexation; and

WHEREAS, the Reapportionment Office reviewed the City’s boundaries and prepared a population summary (“Population Summary”) and reapportionment plan (“Reapportionment Plan”), which were presented to the City, attached hereto as Exhibit A and Exhibit B, respectively; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and City Council have determined that it is necessary and proper to amend the Charter of the City of Doraville under the Home Rule Powers of O.C.G.A. Section 36-35-1, et seg., to reapportion the election districts as proposed by the Apportionment Office, pursuant to O.C.G.A. Section 36-35-4.1; and

WHEREAS, a notice on the matter of reapportionment was published in The Champion, the official legal organ of DeKalb County, Georgia, on January 29, 2026, February 5, 2026, and February 12, 2026; and

WHEREAS, on February 11, 2026, and on February 18, 2026, public hearings were held to provide public input into said reapportionment decision; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and City Council have determined that the Reapportionment Plan attached hereto as Exhibit A and the Population Summary attached hereto as Exhibit B meet all of the requirements of O.C.G.A. Section 36-35-4.1 and is in the best interest of the citizens of the City of Doraville.

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED that:

- 1. The Charter of the City of Doraville, Section 5.08, is hereby amended to adopt the Apportionment Plan and Population Summary set forth as Exhibits A and B; and

- 2. The City Manager and City Attorney are hereby authorized and directed, for and on behalf of the City, to file this Ordinance to amend the City Charter with the Secretary of State and the DeKalb County Clerk of Court, pursuant to O.C.G.A Section 36-35-5, and to take such other actions as may be deemed necessary to effectuate the intent of this Ordinance.

- 3. This Ordinance shall become effective on the first day of the month following adoption of this Ordinance or as otherwise provided by law.

A Joseph Geierman, Mayor

SO ORDAINED this 11th day of February, 2026.
